issues.title: Include every deployed worker in the toolchain identity digest.
issues.comment:
**Include every deployed worker in the toolchain identity digest.**

The `identity` map hashes only four workers. The script also copies these files into the sandbox rootfs:

- `bundle-source-prerender.mjs`
- `prerender-build-worker.mjs`
- `prerender-worker.mjs`
- `bounded-input.mjs`
- `compile-runtime.mjs` (from `compile-worker.mjs`)

`checkpoint-b-toolchain.json` derives its `digest` from `identity`. If one of the omitted files changes, the prerender compile and render path changes, but the toolchain digest stays the same. A reader of the evidence then cannot tell that the prerender toolchain changed.

Hash every file that the script copies into the rootfs.

<details>
<summary>🛡️ Proposed fix</summary>

```diff
-const identity = Object.fromEntries(
-  [
-    'browser-checks.mjs',
-    'bundle-source.mjs',
-    'capture-worker.mjs',
-    'performance-worker.mjs',
-  ].map((name) => [
-    name,
-    createHash('sha256')
-      .update(readFileSync(path.join(scratch, name)))
-      .digest('hex'),
-  ])
-);
+const identity = Object.fromEntries([
+  ...[
+    'browser-checks.mjs',
+    'bundle-source.mjs',
+    'bundle-source-prerender.mjs',
+    'capture-worker.mjs',
+    'performance-worker.mjs',
+  ].map((name) => [name, path.join(scratch, name)]),
+  ['compile-runtime.mjs', compiler],
+  ...[
+    'tools/experience-runner/prerender-build-worker.mjs',
+    'tests/experience-performance/prerender-worker.mjs',
+    'tests/experience-performance/bounded-input.mjs',
+  ].map((source) => [path.basename(source), path.join(app, source)]),
+].map(([name, file]) => [
+  name,
+  createHash('sha256').update(readFileSync(file)).digest('hex'),
+]));
```
</details>

issues.title: Hash the five omitted worker files in the toolchain identity.
issues.comment:
**Hash the five omitted worker files in the toolchain identity.**

The `identity` map hashes four worker files. The script also copies five more worker files into the `node24` rootfs, and no other profile field covers them. If one of them changes, the compile and render path can change while `checkpoint-b-toolchain.json` keeps the same `digest`.

`digest` is computed over the whole `profile`. The `identity` map is only the `workers` field of that profile. The omitted files do not appear in any other profile field:
- `hostShell` hashes only `checkpoint-b-host.js`.
- `platformFiles` hashes only the `experience-sdk` and `shared` package sources.
- `policy` hashes only `oci-policy.ts` and `local-oci-executor.ts`.

Add the five files to the identity map:

<details>
<summary>🛡️ Proposed fix</summary>

```diff
-const identity = Object.fromEntries(
-  [
-    'browser-checks.mjs',
-    'bundle-source.mjs',
-    'capture-worker.mjs',
-    'performance-worker.mjs',
-  ].map((name) => [
-    name,
-    createHash('sha256')
-      .update(readFileSync(path.join(scratch, name)))
-      .digest('hex'),
-  ])
-);
+const identity = Object.fromEntries([
+  ...[
+    'browser-checks.mjs',
+    'bundle-source.mjs',
+    'bundle-source-prerender.mjs',
+    'capture-worker.mjs',
+    'performance-worker.mjs',
+  ].map((name) => [name, path.join(scratch, name)]),
+  ['compile-runtime.mjs', compiler],
+  ...[
+    'tools/experience-runner/prerender-build-worker.mjs',
+    'tests/experience-performance/prerender-worker.mjs',
+    'tests/experience-performance/bounded-input.mjs',
+  ].map((source) => [path.basename(source), path.join(app, source)]),
+].map(([name, file]) => [
+  name,
+  createHash('sha256').update(readFileSync(file)).digest('hex'),
+]));
```
</details>
